purpose: MXF Project source/text decoding and compact-retention review for Bella.
request: OK, let's lock those Clip Name rules in for Bella. Next, how do Media Composer and MDVX read Project from MXF, and what should Bella read and keep?
status: The simplified header Project -> qualified file-owned Project -> blank rule and its presented text/availability/retention details were explicitly approved on 2026-10-22. Unimplemented requirements; historical research and proposal-revision findings remain unchanged.

findings.topic: Header Project writer derives from final master lookup
findings.conclusion: The object at this+0x398 is labelled _finalMasterMob by its assertion. The writer calls FindProjectName on it with argument 0 and a 64-byte char buffer initially empty, converts that through AvText to wide Unicode, and sets the Avid header ProjectName property. The FindProjectName return is not tested here. This does not prove the input is the currently open global project, guarantee a nonempty Project, or establish a universal length/encoding rule for all writers.

findings.topic: Summary Project reader has typed getter and combined success gates
findings.conclusion: This helper reads two summary IDs and typed Project text; ordinary output conversion occurs only after the three getter calls succeed. It does not establish universal precedence between summary Project and mob-owned tagged values, nor all-or-nothing output rollback under later exceptions.

findings.topic: Generic owner attribute import and string conversion
findings.conclusion: Generic composition import obtains the supplied mob-owned attribute list, converts typed tagged attributes and attaches the list to that composition. The converter distinguishes integer, opaque and string categories. String category 12 reads the typed string, runs ConvertUnicodeToInternal and sets a char-string attribute; special __AttributeList and __PortableObject strings enter separate object-handling branches. This is general attribute import, not a proven Project-specific source-selection rule.
findings.unicodeLimit: Both attribute names and string values use ConvertUnicodeToInternal. Prior traced converter has a domain-flag ASCII-cleanup/wcstombs path and an AvText system-encoding path. It is not proof of lossless Unicode preservation or a universal raw MacRoman/UTF-8 wire encoding.

findings.topic: DMS1 Project is a separate typed descriptive route
findings.conclusion: The function obtains the composition _USER list, follows the typed DMS1ClipFramework Projects reference to a DMS1Project, reads its Name with GetStringPropFromObject, converts it through ConvertUnicodeToInternal, and sets _PJ. A separate DMS1Project_Number route can set Production. This demonstrates an explicit descriptive-metadata to internal-attribute mapping, not semantic equivalence of every production project name to the Avid Project column.

ScanDMS1File traverses a typed track/segment/framework chain and compares the framework class identity against two fixed alternatives. Only the matching Project-bearing branch calls ScanDMS1ForProject, followed by people/take handling; the other recognized branch calls the scene scanner. Unsupported/missing traversal or unmatched class exits false. These extracts alone do not connect DMS1 scanning to every ordinary media scanner path.
